Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 16
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the sources and reversed the roles of the drinks—incorrectly calling Kir a digestif/bedtime drink and downplaying the explicit evidence that a hot toddy is “traditionally drunk as a nightcap before retiring for the night.” This led the Planner to direct the synthesis toward the wrong conclusion (stating Kir as the bedtime drink), despite prior results showing Kir is an aperitif (pre-meal) and hot toddy is the traditional nightcap.
